title: Owner acceptance in the DAW of every example and the initiative's Definition of Done
description:
## Intent

Owner acceptance of the initiative in the DAW.

## Steps (manual, the owner with the DAW)

1. `scripts/daw-export-smoke.sh` green.
2. Open each exported example in the DAW; for each, A/B against `apricity render`: timing, chords, mix, loudness (within 1 LU per M3's check).
3. Export one score from the web app (after the web task lands) and open it.
4. Check the initiative's Definition of Done item by item; record results in a comment on apricitus-6edba8.

## Verification

A comment on the initiative with the DAW version, per-example results, and bugs filed for any mismatch.

## Release

No commit.
